name: Geary Gaidar
source:
A member of the "魔シキ封錬の匠" who escaped to the Kingdom of Belgarad.
She is still fixated on overthrowing the "rule of God" and takes action to achieve that goal. The difference between her and Vaclav Gaidar, who was also a member of the organization and of the same bloodline, is that she hates defeat more than she wants to restore the status of humans. She does not like to retreat, even temporarily, even if it is for her own purpose. She has a strong sadistic nature and gets angry if she is unable to launch an offensive against her opponent. She judges whether she can use the people around her, and this extends to her allies as well. Once she determines that someone is an enemy, she shows no mercy and punishes them harshly. However, she seems to show her own mercy to those she judges to be useful.
